bug_semantics: CWE-94 AppleScript/JXA injection: a SQL-controlled tab URL is fmt.Sprintf'd into an embedded AppleScript/JXA template and executed with osascript -e. At app tag 0.4.4 (0abd46087f7085339914c79592cdf44ebd3ce5a1) plugins/chrome/tabs.go:141 does exec.Command("osascript", "-e", fmt.Sprintf(newTabScript, url)) on INSERT row[2]; tabs.go:169 does fmt.Sprintf(setURLScript, pk, url) on UPDATE. newTab.applescript is `make new tab with properties {URL:"%s"}`; a quote+newline payload closes that record and appends statements such as `do shell script`. The same unescaped-URL sink exists in the brave/edge copies and in safari tabs.go. First-party GHSA-hrj8-hjv8-mgwc also patches reminders (text/template into AppleScript), same CWE class.
flaw_origin: The chrome/brave/edge plugins were first added as new files in d2ecb36e6375c0bf61d3de3da4e252e1f84a0445 (2024-07-20, 'Add chromium based plugin') already interpolating the SQL url into osascript with no escaping. git log -L 141,141:plugins/chrome/tabs.go at 0.4.4 and blame of that sprintf line show only this commit; parent c8eeb12eb862b49c965aa53dbae137791f6a088a has no plugins/chrome|brave|edge/tabs.go. The same URL-into-osascript pattern was written ~3h earlier for Safari in that parent (c8eeb12 plugins/safari/tabs.go:145); chrome is a new-file copy of the pattern, not a git mv. a1d26cda354af015ed411175471c956ffc038d72 later added RPC schema descriptions but left the sprintf sink intact (advisory line 141 is the post-update location).
